target_info.name: RW Aurigae
target_info.kind: Estrella variable T Tauri con ocultaciones por polvo
target_info.description: Estrella joven T Tauri con disco protoplanetario. No se traslada en el cielo, pero su brillo cae drásticamente debido a filamentos de polvo circunestelar.

blink.provenance: NASA IRSA SPHEREx Data Standard Service
blink.tap_query_executed: SELECT 'https://irsa.ipac.caltech.edu/' || a.uri || '?center=76.9562,30.4014d&size=0.0833' AS uri, p.time_bounds_lower, p.energy_bandpassname, p.time_bounds_upper, p.provenance_version FROM spherex.artifact a JOIN spherex.plane p ON a.planeid = p.planeid WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', 76.9562, 30.4014), p.poly) ORDER BY p.time_bounds_lower
